status: Initial, incomplete static map; names describe observed behavior and are not original symbols.

regions.name: boot_reset
regions.evidence: Cartridge entry branches here; configures IRQ/system stacks and branches through literal 0x0810D65D.

regions.name: irq_dispatch
regions.evidence: Installed at 0x03007FFC; checks IE/IF, acknowledges selected bit and branches through a handler table.

regions.name: boot_address_literals
regions.evidence: Words 0x03007FFC, 0x0810D65D and 0x03001F10 referenced by reset/IRQ code.

regions.name: state_increment_word10_if_flag22
regions.evidence: Reads byte at 0x02029F30+0x22; increments word at +0x10 if nonzero; returns via BX. Purpose unconfirmed.

regions.name: game_entry_trampoline
regions.evidence: Called by startup_thumb; calls 0x08001424 and returns. No game loop inferred here.

regions.name: startup_thumb
regions.evidence: Reset target uses Thumb bit; calls 0x0810C228, 0x0800152C and 0x0810C90C, then returns.
